name: SA medical heating and cooling concession
summary: Yearly energy concession for South Australians with a medical condition severely worsened by hot or cold weather.
key: The current concession amount is $291.27 a year.
who: Have, or be the parent of a child with, a qualifying medical condition certified by a doctor
Use an air conditioner at the address for medical heating or cooling
Have an eligible concession card or Centrelink payment
how: Download the application form, complete it with your doctor, and email it to MHC@sa.gov.au.
catches: The page does not name which concession cards are eligible; check before relying on a Health Care Card.
